headline: Democrats take Congress as Ottawa tables its federal budget
briefing: Democrats won control of the U.S. House and, per AP, the Senate in Tuesday's midterms, and Ontario's premier says he will send ministers to Washington after the new Congress is sworn in. Ottawa tables its federal budget today amid trade uncertainty. In Toronto, Premier Ford has ruled out a second 'New Deal' for the city as it faces a roughly $1.1-billion budget gap.
